name: @custom-wayback/pipeline
description: Runtime-agnostic ingestion logic shared by the local Node crawler and the Cloudflare Workers queue consumer: URL canonicalisation, Wayback CDX specs and parsing, page selection, the injected mirror runtime, and month/domain helpers. Standard globals only (URL, URLSearchParams, TextDecoder/TextEncoder, Intl, Date) -- no Node builtins, no DOM, no filesystem, no process.
